internal_alignment: Speaking and Listening SL.1.4: describe a person, place, thing, or event with relevant details in complete sentences. SL.1.5: add drawings to clarify ideas. The child describes a thing (Page 1), a place (Page 2), a person (Page 3), then chooses their own topic for an independent show and tell (Page 4). Every page includes a simple speaking activity. Sentence frames fade across the pack: full frames on page 1, shorter frames on page 2, complete starters on page 3, open lines on page 4, per the user's standing refinement that writing packs gradually reduce frames and provide genuine independent writing.
pack: Grade 1 Communication: Describe and Show It

pages_detail.activities: The child describes a thing they love out loud, then writes two complete describing sentences using the full sentence frames, and draws the thing.
pages_detail.title: Describe a Thing

pages_detail.activities: The child draws a place they love, then writes what they can see and hear there, using the 'I chose' frame.
pages_detail.title: Describe a Place

pages_detail.activities: The child describes a special person, how they look and how they make them feel, using the complete left-aligned starters, and draws them.
pages_detail.title: Describe a Person

pages_detail.activities: The child chooses their own person, place, thing, or event, draws it, writes about it, and shows it to someone, telling them three things about it, with the Show and Tell reminder.
pages_detail.title: My Show and Tell
